messages.subject: theme_<journal_name> library
parts:
Hi All,

Please see this post http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/692d5741ad80acb1

I don't want this to seem like a dupe, feedback was that this was a
more appropriate place for this topic. In short, the OP will give you
a quick idea of my thought(s) around creating a repository for user
created themes with specific tweaks/settings for different journals,
and I'm hoping to find someone to work with me on the idea rather than
me putting unpolished thoughts/templates/guides out and not achieving
any momentum with the idea.

If you're interested, please contact me,

Thanks
